top3.headline: OpenAI opens ChatGPT to business profiles and customer-facing agents
top3.whyItMatters: Customers may meet your brand inside ChatGPT first; decide who owns that profile.

top3.headline: Claude now runs full apps like Adobe and Box beside the chat
top3.whyItMatters: Your software vendors are becoming apps inside Claude; check which ones your teams already use.

top3.headline: OpenRouter, now part of Stripe, serves 125% more weekly tokens
top3.whyItMatters: Model routing is consolidating under payments players, which may shape what you pay for AI.

items.title: Cursor rebuilds Projects so teams and their agents share one workspace
items.takeaway: Cursor says teammates' agents can now coordinate with each other inside a shared project.
items.soWhat: Agent work is becoming a team activity, so plan for shared context and permissions.

items.title: OpenRouter, now part of Stripe, serves 125% more weekly tokens
items.takeaway: Patrick Collison says weekly tokens are up about 125% since the August acquisition announcement.
items.soWhat: Payments companies now want to own how businesses route and pay for AI models.

items.title: Anthropic gives paid Claude users one free full usage reset
items.takeaway: Usable before December 10; Anthropic says recent issues consumed more limits than intended.
items.soWhat: Teams that hit Claude limits recently can reclaim capacity now in Settings, Usage.

items.title: Matt Pocock's 'Home Repo' runs agents across many repos
items.takeaway: One repo holds skills, steering files and wiki; AGENTS.md points to clones of the other repos.
items.soWhat: A single agent home makes sweeping changes across many codebases easier to manage.

items.title: Claude now runs full apps like Adobe and Box beside the chat
items.takeaway: Expanded MCP Apps support lets app tools and embedded sites run inside Claude on web and desktop.
items.soWhat: Claude is becoming the place work happens, not just a chat window beside your tools.

items.title: OpenAI lets businesses build agents that answer customers in ChatGPT
items.takeaway: In beta: claim a business profile, manage its information, see engagement and build a Business Agent.
items.soWhat: ChatGPT is becoming a storefront, so claim your profile before others describe you.

items.title: Google agents mathematically verify the Signal protocol's code
items.takeaway: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon and AlphaProof Code checked Signal's code down to compiled device code.
items.soWhat: Machine-checked proofs of critical code are becoming practical, which raises the bar for security assurance.

items.title: Claude adds Whiteboards, Sheets and Data workspaces
items.takeaway: Claude is rolling out three tools: plan on a board, build a tracker in a sheet, tell a story with data.
items.soWhat: Claude now competes directly with office suites for planning and analysis work.

items.title: OpenAI turns its own defenses into customer security tools
items.takeaway: OpenAI says frontier models found and fixed important vulnerabilities, and will announce cyber products in a Thursday keynote.
items.soWhat: Frontier labs are moving into security products; watch Thursday before renewing security tooling.

items.title: Google's /swarm pairs builder and critic agents in Antigravity
items.takeaway: In Google's demo, builder and critic subagents looped across Blender and Three.js, checking their own renders, to build a playable 3D game.
items.soWhat: Agents that review their own output are becoming a built-in product feature, not custom plumbing.

related.name: The Verge: Gemini 4 Carbon agent swarm

items.title: eBay appears to shut out third-party AI shopping agents
items.takeaway: The Verge reports eBay appears to have closed the door on outside AI agents.
items.soWhat: Big marketplaces may block agents, so agent commerce plans need platform permission.

items.title: Vercel's security agent found 57,897 vulnerabilities in its first week
items.takeaway: Rauch reports 6,029 critical or high findings and 14,665 already patched by the agent; numbers are Vercel's own.
items.soWhat: Agent-run code review now finds flaws at a scale human teams cannot triage alone.

items.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon for long-horizon agent work
items.takeaway: Built for sustained tasks in software, security and science; live in the Gemini API, AI Studio and Gemini for business.
items.soWhat: Another frontier option for long-running agents is now widely available; benchmark it against your current model.

items.title: Meng To looped a cheap model through 800 page designs
items.takeaway: Over 24 hours, each version was screenshotted, critiqued and rebuilt; he reports a $0 model bill.
items.soWhat: Cheap models in critique loops can explore design options at near-zero cost.

items.title: Anthropic launches the roadshow for its proposed IPO
items.takeaway: Anthropic says an SEC registration statement is filed but not yet effective; The Verge reports a $1.4 trillion target.
items.soWhat: A core enterprise AI vendor is heading to public markets, which brings public disclosure.

items.title: Meng To builds a landing page with Opus 5.5 and Lottie AI
items.takeaway: The animated card, logo and menu icons are Lottie files, not videos; the card is 51 KB.
items.soWhat: AI tools now produce rich, lightweight motion design that loads fast on any site.

items.title: Anthropic: 'This codebase is yours' makes Fable 5.2 refactor more
items.takeaway: In Anthropic's tests the line led the model to merge repeated code in about half of tries, versus under a tenth without it.
items.soWhat: Ownership framing in prompts measurably changes agent behavior; add it to your team's coding setup.

items.title: Lyn Alden: wary of Huang's tenure, bullish on 2027 GPU demand
items.takeaway: She calls herself neutral to bearish on Huang as CEO and bullish on GPU demand in 2027.
items.soWhat: A respected macro voice separates Nvidia's leadership risk from the demand for AI compute.

items.title: Verge: what is known about the Nvidia spy scandal targeting Huang
items.takeaway: Stratechery says the story got worse today, and The Atlantic calls it a scandal at the center of the economy.
items.soWhat: Leadership risk at the top AI chip supplier keeps growing; watch your supply exposure.

items.title: Nathan Benaich: defenders need open cyber models too
items.takeaway: He says Hugging Face found API guardrails slowed an intrusion probe and used a self-hosted open model.
items.soWhat: Closed-model guardrails can block your own security team; keep an open-model option for incidents.

hotOnX.text: All Pro, Max, Ultra and Team users get one free full reset across all models and limits, before December 10.
hotOnX.note: Heavy users felt recent limit problems and want capacity back.

hotOnX.text: Businesses in ChatGPT is in beta: claim your profile, see insights and build a Business Agent.
hotOnX.note: Brands see ChatGPT turning into a place customers find them.

hotOnX.text: Claude supports more of MCP Apps; interactive connectors open Adobe, Atlassian and Box beside the chat.
hotOnX.note: Builders see Claude becoming a host for full apps.

hotOnX.text: Gemini 4 Carbon with AlphaProof Code produced 6M+ lines of Lean proofs verifying the Signal protocol.
hotOnX.note: Provably correct code at this scale is new.

hotOnX.note: Teams juggling many repos want one place to run agents.
